as_told.title: Gemini 11 UFO electromagnetic outage and Simpkinson archive photo

plain: During NASA's Gemini 11 flight in 1966, an object reportedly passed near the capsule carrying the astronauts Pete Conrad and Richard Gordon, and their batteries then failed: "Battery Charlie was drained," as Michels reads it from the mission transcripts. In a later episode he says he talked it over with a researcher named Kevin Knuth and came away thinking "there was an actual UFO around Gemini 11 that caused this electromagnetic outage," and he points to a photo from a NASA archive he links to the name Simpkinson. If true, it would mean astronauts in orbit had an encounter that knocked out their power.
